$schema_notes.purpose: One JSON object per account. Batch-load per market. TAM is left null at target-creation time and computed by the ingest pipeline in Step 4 of the playbook (see sophi_tam_rerun_playbook.md).

field_rules.name: string, REQUIRED. Must match the WAS_Scoring sheet spelling exactly. Do not abbreviate.
field_rules.type: enum, REQUIRED. One of: Hotel, Restaurant, Hospital, Venue, Casino, Airport, Commercial. Only Hotel and Restaurant contribute to TAM.
field_rules.tam: number or null. Leave null at target-creation time; the ingest computes it.
field_rules.rooms: integer or null. Hotels only. Total room count.
field_rules.seats: integer or null. Restaurants only. Total seat capacity.
field_rules.area: string, REQUIRED. Submarket name (e.g., 'Downtown', 'Cherry Creek', 'Scottsdale', 'Mass Ave'). Drives the downtown-vs-suburban tier split.
field_rules.mgmt: string. Brand-management company (White Lodging, Aimbridge, Pyramid Global, HEI, Highgate, StepStone, etc.). Empty if owner-operated or brand-managed by the flag itself.
field_rules.known_valet_op: string or null. If known, format as 'OperatorName [source](https://...)'. If unknown at target-creation, leave null and fill during operator research (Step 2).
